$schema: MIGRAPILOT_STATUS — canonical cross-agent state. Update on every material change.

rules.easyFirst: Do not start deep capability work while meaningful easy user-facing items remain.
rules.provenLive: PROVEN_LIVE requires the real user-facing workflow to pass. Code existing and tests passing is NOT proof.
rules.acceptanceGate: The gate is the app's own test command + tsc -b + live browser acceptance. A pre-commit hook is not the acceptance suite.
rules.costDiscipline: owned -> open-source -> self-hosted -> free tier -> partner credits -> paid. No recurring paid dependency enters quietly.
rules.honestUnavailable: A capability that is not ready must refuse truthfully rather than appear to work.

activeLane.objective: Finish common file/document behaviour before deeper capabilities.
activeLane.currentStep: Citation attribution made deterministic and deployed; LIVE PROOF BLOCKED by the workstation model backend failing every generation.

SECURITY_HARDENING.name: Separate Hetzner project for DR credential isolation
SECURITY_HARDENING.detail: Hetzner keys are project-scoped with no per-bucket IAM (proven: one key reached fsn1, nbg1, hel1, ash, hil). Real isolation needs a separate project. NOT a blocker to product work.
SECURITY_HARDENING.needsFromOwner: Create the project + Object Storage credentials + DR bucket in the Hetzner console.

IMPLEMENTED_NEEDS_LIVE_PROOF: Deterministic source attribution — the engine emits a `grounding` frame naming the files it put in front of the model; the consumer attributes from that, intersected with the caller library. Replaces `answer.includes(filename)`.

driftControl.assumption: MinIO data shares cloud-core's 32GB OS filesystem, so media growth would fill the OS disk.
driftControl.disprovedBy: MINIO_VOLUMES=/mnt/client-storage — a dedicated 200GB disk, 175GB free. I had measured / instead of MinIO's configured volume.

driftControl.assumption: There is no off-host backup of anything.
driftControl.disprovedBy: PBS CT 9002 runs a daily restic backup of the whole datastore to Hetzner Object Storage (192GiB), plus a weekly restore drill.
driftControl.corrected: An off-host copy existed; the gap was object granularity, not existence.

driftControl.assumption: Follow-up image context is broken — every follow-up is answered blind.
driftControl.disprovedBy: Consumer trace showed requested:1 sent:0 dropped:1 — the artifact had been deleted by me minutes earlier. A clean test showed sent:1 and has_image:true.
driftControl.corrected: Follow-up image context works. No second mechanism was built.

driftControl.assumption: The PDF upload rejection is a bug/regression.
driftControl.disprovedBy: storage.ts deliberately excludes pdf/docx/xlsx with a comment explaining that accepting them would fabricate a capability.
driftControl.corrected: It is an intentional honest refusal; the work is building extraction.

driftControl.assumption: Backups for VM103 were weekly (5 snapshots).
driftControl.disprovedBy: My own head -6 truncation. Real: 11 snapshots, daily, 6-10s incremental.
systemctl EnvironmentFiles — brain-postgres.env loads after brain.env and wins.

driftControl.assumption: A green pre-commit hook means the build is green.
driftControl.disprovedBy: Hook runs tsc --noEmit; the suite runs tsc -b. A committed test broke npm test.
driftControl.corrected: Acceptance gate is the app's own test command + tsc -b + live browser.

driftControl.assumption: A conversation that predates a feature will show its new UI once the feature ships.
driftControl.disprovedBy: A pre-fileRefs conversation showed no historical card after detach — the record was never written for turns stored before M21.
driftControl.corrected: Historical cards exist only for turns stored after the feature. Not a regression; older threads have no record to render.

driftControl.assumption: My brain deploy broke the turn path — two turns returned no_output straight after it.
driftControl.disprovedBy: Rolled the brain back; turns still failed. Then tested the model host directly: every model returns "unexpected EOF" standalone, with MigraPilot out of the picture.
driftControl.corrected: The change was innocent and has been rolled forward. The fault is the workstation Ollama runner.

driftControl.assumption: "Ollama is inactive" — read from `systemctl is-active ollama` on VM111.
driftControl.disprovedBy: VM111 has no local Ollama; the model runs on the workstation at 100.86.143.93:11434, which returns HTTP 200.
driftControl.corrected: Measured the wrong host. The same wrong-endpoint pattern as the MinIO disk misread.
